question: Regal Bloodlord makes a Bat token at the beginning of each end step if I gained life this turn. If I gained life three separate times this turn, do I create three Bats?

expected.shortAnswer: No: you create only one Bat, however much life you gained.
expected.answer: You create only one Bat token, no matter how much life you gained.
